Subject: Your cheque bounce matter

Dear Ms. Bose,

Thank you for meeting us on 2 March 2025 about your dispute with Sai Textiles Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Panaji.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹21,60,000.

Regards,
Adv. Mrinalini Saraf
